summary: Barclays PLC filed a Form 6-K reporting a PDMR share transaction disclosure under UK market rules. The filing is a routine notification that Group HR Director Tristram Roberts disposed of 200,000 ordinary shares at 4.239 per share on 29 April 2026 via Computershare. There is no corporate event or special situation; it is a standard regulatory disclosure of a managerial share dealing.
